intent: Independently verify readiness of the frozen four-rubric model comparison before interpreting model results.
followup_verification: Recomputed active snapshot fingerprint and runner hash match embedded source; both operational repairs inspected. Initial snapshot remains preserved.
verified_controls: 105 saved Qwen source outputs comprise 81 fixed requests and 24 trajectory turns.
Fixed prompts and full real inventories are consumed from saved evidence, not rebuilt from dirty runtime files.
Trajectory shells change only learner history and current intervention; each model uses its own generated tutor history.
Prior guard mode is explicitly fixed false: these are controlled-state journeys, not autonomous full-state production rollouts.
The four amended primary rubrics and relevant 24 calibration examples with 42 primary annotations are frozen without tuning.
Common judge evidence omits target model identity and private tutor reason.
DeepSeek targets retain their own final target call and attempts, with saved Qwen file and hash as separate provenance.
Ordinary thresholds are 80 percent; factual accuracy threshold is 100 percent; failed calibration makes affected semantic comparisons provisional.

operational_findings.finding: A budget assertion before a retry can discard attempts accumulated by that call before persistence.
operational_findings.recommendation: Return a structured budget error retaining earlier attempts when the budget is exhausted.
operational_findings.scope: Execution evidence preservation; does not block short calibration.

operational_findings.finding: Target generation can attempt format repair after a transport error.
operational_findings.recommendation: Stop format retry on transport errors, matching the judge path.
operational_findings.scope: Operational retry classification; no prompt or rubric change.

inference_limits: Only the 81 fixed requests permit an identical-input comparison.
The 24 trajectory turns permit a controlled-journey comparison with intentionally different later tutor histories.
Historical Qwen calls and a common DeepSeek judge retain temporal and potential self-preference confounds.
This readiness review does not establish calibration validity or behavior acceptance.
